overview: The Medford School Committee met to approve the fiscal year 2027 school budget, select an HVAC replacement option for the Roberts Elementary School, and adjust the educational plan for the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: Approved entering executive session to discuss non-union personnel contract negotiations, a teacher grievance, and SEIU 888 Carpenters Union negotiations.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payrolls, budget transfers, and minutes from the June 1 and June 8 meetings.

items.title: Mustang Moment
items.summary: The committee hosted a performance by the Middle School String Ensemble and recognized the successes of Medford High School's spring athletic teams.

items.title: FY27 Budget Update and Approval
items.summary: Approved the fiscal year 2027 school budget after reviewing adjustments made by administrators to close the remaining $833,398 deficit.

items.title: Roberts Elementary School HVAC Project Update
items.summary: Approved HVAC Option 1 (air to water source heat pumps) and a roof replacement for the Roberts Elementary School project following a presentation of the feasibility study.

items.title: Updated Medford Public Schools Handbook
items.summary: Approved the updated school handbook, which clarifies rules against withholding elementary recess as a disciplinary tool and outlines the academic honesty panel appeal process.

items.title: MSBA Medford High School Building Project Update & Ed Plan Changes
items.summary: Approved revisions to the High School Comprehensive Project educational plan and space summary, consolidating administrative offices and specialty rooms to maximize efficiency.

items.title: Resolution 2026-16 (Space Alternative Study)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the City of Medford share the results of its space study on relocating central administration, the Welcome Center, Kids Corner, and the Medford Family Network prior to finalizing high school design scopes.

items.title: Policy JJH Student Travel Second Reading
items.summary: Waived the second reading and approved updates to Policy JJH regarding student travel.

items.title: Resolution 2026-14 (AI Guidance in Handbook & Policy IJND-AI)
items.summary: Waived the second reading and approved an amendment to Policy IJND-AI prohibiting educators from using artificial intelligence tools to grade or provide feedback on qualitative student work.

items.title: Resolution 2026-15 (Superintendent Evaluation Cadence)
items.summary: Approved a resolution, as amended, to realign the superintendent's evaluation and goal-setting schedule with the academic school year.

items.title: Summer Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Announced the dates for potential summer meetings on July 20 and August 24, 2026, with the next regular meeting scheduled for September 14, 2026.
